title: The effects of impact forces and kinematics of two different stances at straight punch techniques in boxing
no_doi_reason: no DOI in the OpenAlex record; verify by hand before this source is used for anything

methodology: Comparison of impact force and kinematic indicators for the straight punch between orthodox and southpaw stance.
